metadata.scope_note: First-pass canonical matrix limited to current K vs K=1000. K=750 is intentionally excluded from this matrix.

fee_rules.label: Baseline fee rule
fee_rules.description: Status quo fee split. No extra min-margin or min-rate floor beyond the current baseline assumptions.

fee_rules.label: CIP-0023
fee_rules.description: Introduce minPoolMargin while keeping minPoolCost in place.

fee_rules.label: CIP-0082 Stage 2 fee rule
fee_rules.description: Remove minPoolCost and clamp operator rate with minPoolRate = 3%. When paired with K=1000 this acts as Stage 2 plus the Stage 4 K target.

stake_cap_rules.label: Baseline stake cap
stake_cap_rules.description: Single global saturation threshold shared by all pools.

stake_cap_rules.label: CIP-0050
stake_cap_rules.description: Cap reward-eligible stake by both global saturation and pledge leverage.

stake_cap_rules.label: CIP-0037
stake_cap_rules.description: Make saturation pledge-dependent with a 10% lower-limit floor and a 500k ADA pledge reference.

governance_bundles.label: Stability-first incrementalism
governance_bundles.notes: Keep K at the current level for the primary decision; use K=1000 as a pressure test, not as the default rollout.

governance_bundles.label: Viability-first egalitarianism
governance_bundles.notes: Pair fee reform with a moderate leverage guardrail before considering K expansion.

governance_bundles.label: Security-first skin-in-the-game
governance_bundles.notes: Use CIP-0050 as the canonical stake-cap scenario today; keep CIP-0037 as an advanced comparison because it needs extra simulator work.
